Before the first session, install:

- R or Python — [Install R](https://cran.r-project.org/) or [Install Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/)
- Git — [Install Git](https://git-scm.com/)
- A code editor (choose one):
  - [RStudio](https://posit.co/products/open-source/rstudio/) — great for R
  - [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) — great for Python or R
  - [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/) — great for Python or R

You'll also need to [create a GitHub account](https://github.com) before session 3.

Packages: TBD

## ☁️ Cloud environment

If you have issues using R or Python on your work computer, we'll set up a Binder as a backup. Binder is a free online environment where you can run code without installing anything. However, there are some limitations.

- Changes aren't saved between sessions
- Takes time to load
- Limited for later work on your own project

You'll get much more from this programme if you're able to work on your own machine.
